claim: Finance Law 2019 (Law 18-18, art. 35) inserted article 16 bis into Ordinance 75-74 (land register). It governs exactly this duty, and the record never cites it. It settles points the record leaves open or marks searchedNotFound: publication is made in the real-property register of the territorially competent land registry (o8, k35); it comes after the petition is registered at the court registry (o5); it covers every petition concerning a property or real right whose title is published (o1, the broad reading); publication does not freeze the property; and the conservator publishes the final judgment (k17, k18, k50).

source.what: Law 18-18 of 27 December 2018, Finance Law for 2019, article 35 (inserting article 16 bis into Ordinance 75-74 of 12 November 1975, Section I of Title II). Official Journal no. 79 of 30 December 2018, page 15.

quoteArabic: المادة 35 : تدرج ضمن القسم الأول من الباب الثاني من الأمر رقم 75-74 ... مادة 16 مكرر تحرر كما يأتي : "المادة 16 مكرر : تشهر بالسجل العقاري الممسوك بالمحافظة العقارية المختصة إقليميا كل عريضة رفع دعوى تتعلق بعقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر سنده، بعد تسجيلها بأمانة ضبط المحكمة. لا يترتب عن إشهار عريضة رفع الدعوى تجميد أو تعليق أو منع التصرف في العقار أو الحق العيني العقاري. ... يشهر المحافظ العقاري المعني الحكم القضائي النهائي الصادر في الدعوى محل العريضة المشهرة".
consequence: The record should cite Ordinance 75-74 art. 16 bis as a tier-1 basis next to CPCA 17 ¶3. It should then close or regrade o5 (after registration at the court registry), o8 and k35 (the territorially competent land registry, real-property register), and k17, k18 and k50 (the conservator publishes the final judgment). It should state that publication does not stop the defendant disposing of the property. o1's broad reading («كل عريضة») gains a second text, and the grade-D 'not in the store' notes are wrong.

claim: Article 16 bis of Ordinance 75-74 words the condition as «عقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر سنده»: it is the title (السند) that must be published. This answers o7 against its second reading, under which publication would be due for every property, published or not. It also means the test is whether the property's or right's title deed is published, which can happen in an area without a cadastral survey. It is not whether the property is 'registered' in a cadastral sense, which is what slot property_registered and examples ex4 and exB5 ('customary deed', 'not published') suggest.

source.what: Law 18-18 (Finance Law 2019), art. 35, inserting art. 16 bis into Ordinance 75-74; Official Journal no. 79 of 30 December 2018, page 15.

quoteArabic: تشهر بالسجل العقاري الممسوك بالمحافظة العقارية المختصة إقليميا كل عريضة رفع دعوى تتعلق بعقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر سنده، بعد تسجيلها بأمانة ضبط المحكمة.
consequence: o7 should record that a later tier-1 text puts the qualifier on the title («مشهر سنده»), which weakens reading 2. The property_registered question and the n1 message should ask whether the title deed of the property or of the right in dispute is published at the land registry. They should not ask whether the property is surveyed or registered. Otherwise a lawyer holding a published notarial deed on unsurveyed land may answer 'no' and lose the warning.

claim: Decree 76-63, article 85, which the record cites only 'from memory' (o2, grade D), is on the Official Journal page and was not amended by Decree 93-123, which amended only articles 8 to 17, 62 and 89 and repealed article 18. For claims to rescind, annul, revoke or undo rights resulting from published documents, it requires publication made beforehand («مسبقا»). It accepts as proof only a certificate of the conservator or a copy of the petition bearing the publication mention. Mere proof of deposit, which the record's m2 accepts under CPCA 17 ¶3, is not among them.

source.what: Decree 76-63 of 25 March 1976 on the establishment of the land register, article 85, Official Journal no. 30 of 1976 (13 Rabi' II 1396), pages 507-508. The amending Decree 93-123 of 19 May 1993 is in Official Journal no. 34 of 23 May 1993, pages 14-16 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/JO-ARABE/1993/A1993034.pdf); its article 1 lists the articles it amends («تعدل وتتمم أحكام المواد من 8 الى 17 و62 و89») and its article 2 repeals article 18.

quoteArabic: المادة 85 : ان دعاوى القضاء الرامية الى النطق بفسخ أو ابطال أو الغاء أو نقض حقوق ناتجة عن وثائق تم اشهارها، لا يمكن قبولها الا اذا تم اشهارها مسبقا طبقا للمادة 14 – 4 من الامر رقم 75 – 74 ... وإذا تم اثبات هذا الاشهار بموجب شهادة من المحافظ أو تقديم نسخة من الطلب الموجود عليه تأشير الاشهار.
consequence: o2 should quote the tier-1 text and be regraded, not left at D from memory. For the claims article 85 names (annulment or rescission of a published deed: k14, exR2), the record should warn that a deposit receipt (m2) may not satisfy article 85. Article 85 asks for a conservator's certificate or the petition bearing the publication mention, so the protective reading is to obtain actual publication, not only a deposit receipt. The relation between CPCA 17 ¶3 (2008, a later law that accepts proof of deposit) and article 85 should be stated as an open point.

claim: For a claim contesting a provisional registration (ترقيم مؤقت) of a surveyed property, Decree 76-63, article 15 as amended in 1993, sets a period. The claimant has 6 months from the conservator's notification of the non-conciliation record to bring the objection before the court, on pain of the claim being rejected. The claim must be published, and notified to the conservator, within that same period under article 85. The record says no period applies (k25, k54) and has no boundary for this case, so it would say nothing about a deadline that bars the claim.

source.what: Executive Decree 93-123 of 19 May 1993 amending Decree 76-63, article 1 (new article 15 of Decree 76-63), Official Journal no. 34 of 23 May 1993, page 16.

quoteArabic: وتكون للطرف المدعي مهلة ستة (6) اشهر ابتداء من تاريخ التبليغ الذي يتلقاه من المحافظ العقاري ليقدم، تحت طائلة رفض الدعوى، كل اعتراض امام الجهة القضائية المختصة. تشهر الدعاوى القضائية والتي يجب تبليغها الى المحافظ العقاري في نفس المهلة وفقا لأحكام المادة 85 أدناه.
consequence: The record should add a case or boundary for a claim contesting a provisional registration in the land register. It should give the 6-month period counted from the conservator's notification, with the sanction of rejection, and say that publication of the petition and its notification to the conservator must fall within that period, not merely before the first hearing. Otherwise it should hand this case to the periods module with an explicit pointer. k25's 'no period in days' is wrong for this case.

claim: The record treats the first hearing as the only moment that matters, and reads publication as a defence against inadmissibility only. A common case is missing: the defendant sells or charges the property while the case is pending. The law ties protection against later transfers to the petition's publication and its date. Under Ordinance 75-74 art. 16 bis ¶3, a disposal after publication obliges the seller to notify the buyer of the published claim by bailiff, and the notice is attached to the deed. Under Decree 76-63 art. 88 ¶3, once the new owner's deed is published, no step can be taken against the former owner, without prejudice to published claims to rescind, annul, revoke or undo a real right. Publishing only on the eve of the first hearing therefore exposes the client.

source.what: Law 18-18 (Finance Law 2019), art. 35 (Ordinance 75-74 art. 16 bis ¶2-¶3), Official Journal no. 79 of 30 December 2018, page 15. Also Decree 76-63 art. 88 ¶3, Official Journal no. 30 of 1976, page 508 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/JO-ARABE/1976/A1976030.pdf), not amended by Decree 93-123 (which amended only art. 89 in that group).

quoteArabic: إذا تم التصرف في حق عيني عقاري يتعلق بعقار أشهرت بشأنه عريضة رفع الدعوى قبل التصرف، فإنه يستوجب على المتصرف إبلاغ المتصرف له بالدعوى المشهرة عن طريق محضر قضائي، على أن يرفق محضر التبليغ بملف العقد عند تقديمه لإجراء الشهر العقاري. / (76-63 م 88 ف3) انه ابتداء من الاشهار المعطى للعقد أو للقرار القضائي أو للشهادة الموثقة المثبتة الحق لصاحبه الجديد، لا يمكن القيام بأي اجراء من قبل الشخص الرئيسي أو ضد الصاحب السابق لهذا الحق دون الاخلال باشهار الطلبات القضائية الرامية الى فسخ أو ابطال أو الغاء أو نقض حق عيني عقاري.
consequence: p1's message and o5 should say that the petition should be published as soon as it is registered at the court registry, not merely before the first hearing. Only a petition published before a transfer is set up against the buyer (16 bis ¶3), and a transfer published first can cut off steps against the former owner (76-63 art. 88 ¶3). k17's 'searchedNotFound' should be replaced by these tier-1 texts.
